scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor of a gray-bearded elder stepping forward with an open hand toward an ivory-robed man in a linen head wrap and a man wearing a rust-colored mantle. Other robed elders gather beside them among cream tents, golden ground, and distant sunlit hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The approaching elders represent the Levite household heads; the ivory-clad priest and rust-mantled leader represent Eleazar and Joshua, with tribal heads gathered around them. Tents, hills, clothing, faces, and gestures are imaginative staging for the approach in this verse, not historical likenesses or a later allocation of cities.
